mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is continuously active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates only when UNRATE exceeds the threshold.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 255.3) signals a dovish monetary policy environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both conditions to be met simultaneously.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL < 255.3
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL < 255.3 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong housing activity (HOUST > 1200), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to potential monetary tightening and economic overheating.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 3.5% AND HOUST > 1200 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is continuously active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST is above 1200 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 109.0 over the past 3 months signals a weakening economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates only when INDPRO falls below the threshold.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 109.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1300) and high residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 520000) signal robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal requires both conditions to be met simultaneously.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1300 AND RSAFS > 520000 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic output and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is continuously active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above 109.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
